name: प्रधानमंत्री जनधन योजना
description: National mission for financial inclusion providing zero-balance bank accounts with RuPay debit card and insurance.
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay card, accident insurance, overdraft, DBT access.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen (resident) above 10 years; one account per person.
steps: Visit bank/Bank Mitra with Aadhaar and proof.
